content:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up: rolling deploy for runtime v4.0.1 in 10m. Canary 5% -> 25 -> 100.
Samir Patel: Confirming pin to v4.0.1; rollback target v4.0.0.
Ruth Kim: Please add explicit suppression for deploybot auto-revert for the first 15m (we want humans on-call).
deploy-bot: Notice: rollout scheduled at 04:15 UTC for runtime v4.0.1. Auto-revert enabled by default.
Lena Ortiz: ops-oncall will hold manual revert authority; suppress auto-revert for first 15m.
ops-oncall: Suppressing auto-revert now. Monitoring gates: p95>250ms OR error_rate>0.4% sustained 3m -> alert only. Manual revert ok.
Samir Patel: Rollback commands if needed:
```
/ops/release revert --to v4.0.0 --scope canary --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 5%. Metrics: p95=115ms, errors=0.02%.
ops-oncall: p95 spike to 280ms at 04:18 UTC. Opening bridge.
Samir Patel: Collect traces and stack dumps, but given the window, execute manual canary revert.
ops-oncall: Running revert now.

deploy-bot: Revert acknowledged. Rolling canary back to v4.0.0.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary at 0% for v4.0.1, p95 back to 120ms.
Ruth Kim: Good. Ruth will draft a short customer note: "paused rollout for investigation; no customer impact."
Lena Ortiz: Follow-up: re-enable auto-revert after we have a fix + new smoke-pass. Samir, please open a runtime ticket with traces.
Samir Patel: Opening ticket and attaching logs.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks team. Manual rollback executed and comms queued.
